reply_text:
Found two issues in `receipt-lines` against `main`:

1. *[P1] Printed amounts are 100× too large* — `receipt/render.py:2`
   `format_money(1299)` returns `$1299.00`, not `$12.99`; two coffees at 450 cents print as `$900.00` instead of `$9.00`.
   *Fix:* Convert cents to dollars before formatting. Add literal expected-output assertions—the current `tests/test_render.py:10` uses the same broken formatter to generate its expectation.

2. *[P2] The renderer doesn’t use the right-alignment helper* — `receipt/render.py:7`
   Padding the name to 20 characters fixes the amount’s starting position, not its right edge. Different-length amounts end in different columns; `layout.align()` is never called by the renderer.
   *Fix:* Use `align(line['name'], format_money(total))` and test rendered lines with different-length amounts against the 32-column width.

All 3 existing tests pass. No files changed.
